title: docs(pm-dispatch): triage completes a self-labelled card's derivable filing-gate answers at first touch; lanes label pm:retriage; the spot-check covers queued cards
body:
Fixes #24589
Clause-②: no

Every path in this diff is under `.claude/**` (Tier S). It publishes nothing from any package `files[]`, so it carries `skip-changeset`. It stays a draft and lands only by the owning seat after a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on the landing head.

## The ruling, verbatim

Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer directed, in the triage seat's chat (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, 2026-10-19). The maintainer asked 「这种卡你是不是不会处理，结果车道也不接」, then 「或者 skills 应该调整？」, and on the seat's three options answered 「B」.

The four items of the card's "What to change (the ruling, B)" are implemented at the three sites they name. Item 4 holds by construction: no gate, script or `issue-create.mjs` refusal is added; the diff is three rule files.

## What changed

### `references/filing-gate.md`: item 1 (old L27 is now L26 and L27; paid by deleting old L21)

```diff
 - ⛔ 不是卡:席位自己的失误、协议观察与「记住这条」,它们进座位贴或收班简报。
-- ⛔ 不是卡:三类外或无 `reach:` 的 `finding`,它们进 Acceptance notes 带 `carrier:`。
 - 「搭下个碰 X 的 PR」不算 `carrier:`;已落地工作欠的后续照立卡,⛔ 不按「不是卡」压下。
 ...
 - POST 前正文答三件:类别 ①–④、动手的读者(哪席哪步)、查重查询与命中数(含 closed)。
-- 缺任一件的卡由分诊首触即关、不定级,关单一行点名缺的是哪一件。
+- 缺件卡由分诊首触补齐能从卡与一次检索推导的三件,写进定级评论并定级。
+- 补不齐(四类皆非,或 `finding` 无 `reach:`)者才因缺件首触即关 not_planned,一行点名所缺。
```

- 「三件」 refers to the line directly above (category ①–④, the reader who acts, the dedupe query with its hit count, closed included). It is referred to, not restated. That line is the filer's POST obligation and is unchanged.
- 「写进定级评论」 is the `Triage: lands in …` audit comment of `triage-duties.md` L67. 「并定级」 replaces the ruled-away 「不定级」.
- 「因缺件」 scopes the "only" to closing for missing answers. The grading-time closures in `triage-duties.md` L61–L62 (「无则关」 and the `tooling` three-door close) still stand: a completed card is graded, and grading can still close it there.
- `not_planned` is spelled bare, as `triage-duties.md` L61 and L63 spell it.
- Two lines because one does not fit: the tightest one-line spelling of item 1 measures 138 B against the 120 B cap, and that spelling already drops "from the card and a search" and the grading comment.

**Payment: deleted old L21**, 「⛔ 不是卡:三类外或无 `reach:` 的 `finding`,它们进 Acceptance notes 带 `carrier:`。」 Both of its halves have a home elsewhere:

- *An out-of-class or reach-less finding is not a card.* The filer side is in the same file: L10 「立卡只为四类…⛔ 其余一律不立卡」 and L11 「其内的 `finding` 限三类且带 `reach:`」. The triage side is the new L27. `SKILL.md` L112 (the `finding` row) has 「三类外关 not planned」.
- *It goes to Acceptance notes with a `carrier:`.* See `SKILL.md` L282 「`out_of_scope_findings` 每条 … 或 `carrier:`(承接者);皆无 ⇒ Acceptance notes。」, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L52–L53 (`carrier:` defined: 「卡号或人,⛔ 非下个碰 X 的 PR」), and `triage-duties.md` L44 「其余进 PR `## Acceptance notes`,⛔ 不立卡」.
- Why this line: no other line in the file is restated in full elsewhere. L3 is the opener that every references file carries. Old L21 sits next to the new rule and covers the same population, reach-less findings.

### `references/execution-duties.md` L11: item 2, compressed in place

```diff
-- 自贴 `domain:*` 卡:车道合域表且正文齐 `filing-gate.md` 三件 ⇒ 候选;缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`。
+- 自贴 `domain:*` 卡:合域表且齐立卡门三件 ⇒ 候选;缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`,⛔ 只评论不算。
```

- 「缺一 ⇒ 挂 `pm:retriage`」 is kept byte for byte, and 「⛔ 只评论不算」 is added. Appending the clause to the unchanged line measures 138 B, so the line is compressed in place and no other line pays:
  - 「车道」 is dropped. The subject is already the self-applied `domain:*` label, and 「合域表」 is the same test.
  - 「`filing-gate.md`」 becomes 「立卡门」. `SKILL.md` L172 uses that spelling for the same rule (「正文齐立卡门三件」), and it is the `## 立卡门` heading of `filing-gate.md`.
  - 「正文」 is dropped on purpose. Under item 1, triage posts the completed answers in its grading comment, not in the body. With 「正文齐」, a lane would send a card that triage had already completed back to `pm:retriage`. `SKILL.md` L172 keeps 「正文齐」, which is right for its own population: untriaged self-labelled cards, where the body is the only place the answers can be.
- The ruling's reason, "the label is what puts the card in triage's sweep", is not spelled on the rule line because it already has a home: `state-machine.md` L10 「交接即标签:只写交接评论而不同笔挂标 = 空交接,收件箱只认标签。」 and `dispatch-runbook.md` L112.

### `references/triage-duties.md` L17: item 3, rewritten in place

```diff
-- 自贴卡抽查:窗内新派发且 `domain:*` 事件与建卡同分钟者,逐张核车道、三件;⛔ 不凭 actor。
+- 自贴卡抽查:窗内新建且 `domain:*` 事件与建卡同分钟,逐张核车道、补齐三件;⛔ 不凭 actor。
```

- 「新派发」 becomes 「新建」. The population is now every card created in the window whose `domain:*` event shares the creation minute, whatever its `pm:*` state. That includes `pm:queue`, which is exactly the population 「新派发」 left out.
- **Deviation, declared:** the explicit 「(含 `pm:queue`)」 does not fit. It measures 139 B (136 B in its tightest position) against the 120 B cap, and this file has no line whose content is restated in full elsewhere to pay for a second line. The inclusion is therefore carried by 「新建」, not spelled out.
- 「三件」 becomes 「补齐三件」: complete them per `filing-gate.md` L26–L27. 「者」 is dropped for bytes. 「逐张」 and 「⛔ 不凭 actor」 are unchanged.

## Line budget

| file | lines before | lines after | ceiling | edited lines, bytes before → after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `references/filing-gate.md` | 64 | 64 | 64 | L27 93 → L26 102 + L27 113; L21 99 → deleted |
| `references/execution-duties.md` | 188 | 188 | 188 | L11 118 → 117 |
| `references/triage-duties.md` | 120 | 120 | 120 | L17 120 → 120 |

No `CEILINGS` row moves. No re-wrap is used as payment. `lengthVerdict(scanLineLengths())` from `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` reports "every line is within 120 bytes" for all three files.

## Acceptance, measured on head `a7111c84e`

```text
$ grep -n '首触即关、不定级' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md; echo "EXIT=$?"
EXIT=1
$ grep -n '立卡门' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md      # same-file control
1:# 立卡门与定级判据
5:## 立卡门
10:- 立卡只为四类,正文首行写立卡门类别 ①–④;⛔ 其余一律不立卡,不论它叫什么。
```

The three files agree:

- **Triage completes what it can derive:** `filing-gate.md` L26–L27, reached from `triage-duties.md` L17 (「补齐三件」).
- **Lanes label `pm:retriage`:** `execution-duties.md` L11 (「⛔ 只评论不算」).
- **The spot-check covers queued self-labelled cards:** `triage-duties.md` L17 (「窗内新建」).

## Gates (local subset, head `a7111c84e`, after merging `origin/main` `5a871e4e4`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 19 commands, and every one exited 0:

- `node scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` and its `--self-test`
- `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`
- `node scripts/pm/check-harness-current.mjs --self-test`
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`
- `pnpm check:` agent-test-spelling, cross-package-test-inputs, doc-authoring, driver-memory-census, gitlink-declared, nul-bytes, pm-governed-merges, pm-half-states, pm-label-write, pm-skill-id-lint, pm-skill-ratchet, refd-timer-probe, skill-frame-sync, watch-hint-literal

`--ran` reconciliation: 「19 derived, 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN」. Notes:

- On its first run `check:doc-formula-expressions` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: formula and lint were unbuilt). That run measured nothing. Both packages were then built under the verify lock, and the re-run exited 0.
- The derived `check:pm-half-states` invocation is the self-test. The live run takes CI's `--provenance` value, so it is NOT MEASURED locally.
- `check:pm-settings-deny-roster` and `check:pm-governed-prose` were also run (both exit 0) because their rosters live under `.claude`.
- This is text-only `.claude/**`: no build closure, no package tests, no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open fork for the seat, not chosen here.** The ruled new L27 closes a non-exception `finding` with no `reach:` at first touch, `not_planned`. `triage-duties.md` L50 says the opposite: 「缺 `reach:` 且非例外 ⇒ 定 `priority:p3`,并入收口卡或清扫卡,⛔ 不单独派发、不因此关卡。」 Both texts cannot hold at once.
  - L50 is outside this card's claimed file surface (three named lines), and choosing between the two rules is not this dev's call. It is reported in the dev report's `open_questions` with options.
  - `SKILL.md` L112 (「三类外关 not planned」), `SKILL.md` L284 (「门外已立卡关 not planned」) and `triage-duties.md` L79 (「三类内无证据拒收」) already lean the new line's way.
  - carrier: the PM seat for this card.
- The reach-less finding rule's former not-a-card bullet is now covered by L10–L11 plus the triage-side close. The `carrier:` token on the next line (now L21) is defined at `SKILL.md` L282 and `os-dev.md` L53. carrier: none, noted only.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:三份分诊/车道规则各改一处。① 立卡门:自贴标签的卡缺「类别/动手的读者/查重」三件时,分诊第一次碰到先自己补齐(从卡面和一次检索就能推出来的),写进定级评论并照常定级;只有补不齐的(四类都不是,或 finding 没有 reach:)才关单 not_planned,一句话说清缺什么。② 车道:发现自贴卡缺件必须挂 `pm:retriage` 标签,只留评论不算。③ 分诊抽查:从「窗内新派发」放宽到「窗内新建」的自贴卡,已排队的也查,逐张核车道并补齐三件。

**为什么改**:当天七张自贴卡缺件。车道按规则不接,但只留了评论没挂标,分诊的扫描又只看已派发的卡,结果卡悬空没人管。按旧条文分诊会把七张全关掉(含一张实测占 CPU 11.8% 的 p1),每张关了重立约四笔写入,还丢线程。改后是补齐定级,少关少重立。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯文本,只动 `.claude/**`,不发布,行数不变、无新门禁;回滚 = revert 本 PR 一个提交。代价一:为腾行删了立卡门里一条「三类外或无 reach: 的 finding 不是卡」,其内容在同文件第 10–11 行和 SKILL.md 报告契约里仍有。代价二:抽查行装不下「含 `pm:queue`」字样,靠「新建」一词涵盖。待定一处:分诊职责第 50 行仍写「缺 reach: 定 p3、不因此关卡」,与这次裁决「finding 无 reach: 首触关」相反,需席位/维护者定夺,本 PR 未选边。
